description: This Java source file defines the class 'TestRailClient', which implements a client for interacting with the TestRail test management system. It includes methods for recording test results based on Cucumber scenarios, extracting test case IDs from scenario tags, and handling API responses. The class uses annotations for dependency injection and conditional component registration, and interacts with external APIs and classes related to test reporting and frameworks.

classes.name: TestRailClient
classes.description: Client for integrating with TestRail to report test case results, configured as a Spring component with conditional registration based on 'TestRailEnabledCondition'. Implements initialization logic and methods for processing and reporting test results.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization method that logs the configured TestRail run ID after bean properties are set.

methods.name: saveScenarioResult
methods.description: Saves the result of a Cucumber Scenario to TestRail by extracting the case ID from scenario tags and submitting pass/fail results accordingly.

methods.name: getScenarioCaseId
methods.description: Parses scenario tags to find and return the TestRail case ID embedded within tags.

methods.name: handleApiError
methods.description: Handles API response errors, throwing runtime exceptions with error details.

methods.name: createFailedRequest
methods.description: Builds a request object for failed test cases including a failure comment.

methods.name: createSuccessRequest
methods.description: Builds a request object for successful test cases including a success comment.

methods.name: createSuccessComment
methods.description: Returns a standard success comment for test case result logging.

methods.name: createFailedComment
methods.description: Attempts to extract detailed failure information from the scenario object, returning a failure comment with details if possible.
